source_judgments: R870's four forms retain the nested optional basic name-list/colon group, required ONLY list and distinct NONE/ALL alternatives. IMPORT:: alone, renaming, designators and generic-spec spellings are not admitted.

C8100 concerns the actual scoping unit, not a containing file. R504 orders IMPORT before IMPLICIT/declarations; R726 has no IMPORT slot inside a derived-type definition despite its default host access.

C8101/C8105 retain actual host identity and the host/use-association OR prior explicit local declaration alternative. A forward local-type diagnostic still needs independent ordering/identity/overlap and repair qualification.
C8102-C8104 preserve ONLY coexistence, NONE/ALL cardinality and the submodule NONE exclusion. Submodule controls need C1412-valid ancestors declaring a separate module procedure.
C8106 forbids hiding explicitly named or ALL-accessible host entities. Bare/default access retains ordinary hiding conditions; no unconditional no-hiding rule is invented.

Seven S meanings separate ordinary and BLOCK ONLY/NONE filters, ALL access, bare/default access and listed-name availability. P4 lists five default scope categories. Ordinary and abstract interface bodies default to NONE, unlike true MODULE-prefixed procedure interface bodies.

BLOCK accessibility and construct/local identifier scope are not ordinary internal-procedure host association. An implicitly declared name used only inside BLOCK can belong to the enclosing scope. IMPORT does not reset the inherited type mapping or permit an IMPLICIT statement inside BLOCK.
Basic named-list unlisted-name behavior and basic named IMPORT inside BLOCK remain explicit source leads, not invented universal permissions or exclusions.

Notes1-5 are not ready-made runtime witnesses. Their incomplete ordering, undefined values, deliberately nonconforming BLOCK example and opaque-type callback need complete source and independently checked real entities.

PRIVATE components neither hide the type identifier nor expose its representation. Future value observations require actual definitions, host/local identity, full interfaces, counters/completion and sensitivity on passing parents.
